entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Oh, okay... I'll wait. I just... I really hope you can help me.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I need to return something. I bought a helmet a little while ago, and it's just not going to work out. I feel terrible about it, I've been a loyal customer for years.
I'm sorry to hear that it's not working out for you, but I can certainly look into that. Do you have your order number handy?

Yes, it's VF-8675309. It was a gift, you see, and the color just clashes completely with their new bike. It's a shame. It's still in the original box, unopened and everything. I just really need the money back right now.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up that order, VF-8675309. One moment... Okay, I see it here. It's for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet in Solar Flare Orange, delivered about 46 days ago.
Yes, that's the one. Is it... is it too late? I was so worried I'd waited too long.
Not at all. I'm checking our policy right now, and for a standard item like this helmet, you are well within our 90-day return window. We can definitely get that processed for you.
Oh, thank goodness! Really? That's such a relief. You have no idea. Thank you so much, Charlie.

Of course. When it comes to a helmet, getting the right fit and color is important for both confidence and safety. I'm happy we can help. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days.
Wow, that's perfect. You've been a wonderful help. I'll get that sent back today. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've made my day!
Great to hear. Thanks again for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
